title: Tokenization and Morphological Fidelity in Uralic NLP: A Cross-Lingual Evaluation

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating downstream part-of-speech (POS) tagging performance (Accuracy and Macro-F1) using different tokenization algorithms (BPE, Unigram, OBPE) across six Uralic languages with varying levels of resource availability and morphological complexity to measure representational disparities and cross-lingual transfer efficacy.
